  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 981 6445 6257
  Passcode: 116311
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/98164456257

  Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access
  and public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

  https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55835  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Citizens' Advisory Commission on
  Disabilities meeting of Thursday, November 14, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55836  Recommendation to receive and file reports from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Citizens' Advisory Commission on Disabilities on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
